description.narrative: The Project consists of a senior IIC A loan of up to the Chilean peso equivalent of US$10M with a 9-year tenor and 1-year grace period. The total project costs are expected to be approx. US$15M and the structure includes a first-loss guarantee of up to US$6.05M from the Clean Technology Fund (CTF). The proposed loan will support Itelecom in developing and installing high efficiency LED technology for public street lighting in Chilean municipalities under an innovative third party, structured financing model. The municipalities expected to be included in the program will be Melipilla, Cartagena, San Javier, Villa Alemana, and Coyhaique. The innovative use of blended climate finance will enable the demonstration of a highly scalable and replicable financing model in the municipal street lighting sector in Chile and throughout the LAC region.
